[b]POLYAMORY PLAYERS
[/b]Download Version Lite if you play poly. The other versions are [b]not compatible[/b] and will have major errors. Incompatibility errors are not bugs and will not be addressed. The story is written to be monogamous, and will not make sense for poly players, so any immersion issues due to this are the player's choice.

[b]DISCLAIMER FOR WRITING STYLE
[/b]The dialogue in this mod is written informally and according to common speech patterns, so it is NOT always grammatically correct. Words may be dropped, conjunctions skipped, and improper words used. Formal grammar is not natural speech and sounds forced and flat when used for dialogue.

This mod is an extremely story-heavy, immersive play-through for Sebastian and includes his friends and family.
This version of Sebastian is not rude or cold, but shy and socially awkward. If you prefer less "shy", set the configuration to turn off the "autism" variant.

This mod assumes you are planning to date/marry Sebastian. It's laid out with a story structure that has a lot of character-building events. There are three download options; each includes the full story with play style differences so choose the one that works best for you.

[color=#8e7cc3][size=5][b]Now for the details...[/b][/size][/color]
This is the base mod and includes all the content, does not have any NSFW content, and has play style options for everyone. Just choose your preferred path.

[b]Slow Burn:[/b] The story paced over 2 1/2 years (minimum) - this is a long-form story and the farmer's relationship with Sebastian unfolds at a relaxed pace.
[list]
[*]A new save is required to see all the content[/*]
[*]Sebastian starts out as [b]non-romaceable[/b] to keep the pace correct and avoid having to worry about his heart level[/*]
[*]Includes reverse confession and proposal, along with a custom wedding[/*]
[*]Includes many additional events over the longer timespan[/*]
[/list]
[b]Speed Run:[/b] The story is slightly compressed and based on heart level, but the events are still chained with shorter gaps so it can be completed in the first year.
[list]
[*]A new save is recommended but not required[/*]
[*]Includes reverse confession and proposal, along with a custom wedding (don't confess or propose before Sebastian does, or these events will be skipped. This will not affect any later events)[/*]
[/list]
[b]Version Lite:[/b] Poly play friendly, all content that breaks poly saves is removed (reverse confession/proposal, custom wedding, marriage string dialogue and repeating events)
[list]
[*]Recommended to use Marry Me for the reverse confession/proposal content and Custom Weddings (I do not know C# code and can't add this myself for multi-spouse)[/*]
[*]Events are set up the same way as Speed Run so it can be played at your pace based on heart level[/*]
[*]Conflicting dialogue that is not keyed specifically to Sebastian is removed (this dialogue would pop up for any character the player marries, not just Sebastian)[/*]
[/list]
